spans.s:
Minute, small, little,
 atomic (opp. स्थूल, महत्); अणोरणीयान्

asked but an atom, a very small quantity,
 न कन्यायाः पिता विद्वान् गृह्णीयात् शुल्कमण्वपि

+ .{@-णु@} n. the fourth part of a Mātrā.
.━{@Comp.@}: अण्वन्तः, अणुतैलम्, अणुभा, अणुमात्र, अणुरेणुः, अणुरेवती, अणुवादः, अणुवीक्षणम्, अणुव्रतानि, अणुव्रीहिः

An atom, a very small particle (an exceedingly small measure); the
 mote in a sunbeam, the smallest perceptible quantity; अस्थूलमनण्वह्नण्वमदीर्घं
 ब्रह्म; अणुं पर्वतीकृ

to magnify; cf. also ‘To make mountains of mole-hills’
.

An atom of time (व्यञ्जनमर्धमात्रा तदर्धम् अणु); it is said
 to be 54,675,000th part of a Muhūrta (48 minutes).

N. of very small grain such as सर्षप, चीनक &c.,
 अनणुषु दशमांशोऽणुष्वथैकादशांशः Līlā.
+ -भा [अण्वी सूक्ष्मा भा प्रभा यस्याः सा] lightning.
+ -मात्र a. [अणुः परिमाणं यस्य अणु-मात्रच्] of the size of an atom.

+ -रेवती [अणुः सूक्ष्मा रेवतीतारेव] N. of a plant
[]
 (दन्तीवृक्ष) Croton Polyandrum.

+ -वादः the doctrine of atoms, atomic theory, the theory that all
 material substances are primarily atoms and secondarily aggregates, and
 that all atoms are eternal.
minute observation, observation of very minute parts.

[अणुः सूक्ष्मो वीक्ष्यते अनेन करणे ल्युट्] an instrument, like the
 microscope, enabling one to discern the smallest objects.
+ -व्रतानि N. of the twelve smaller vows of laymen adhering to the Jain faith.
+ -व्रीहिः [कर्म˚] a fine sort of grain, rice &c.

The superhuman power of becoming as small as an atom, one of the 8
 powers or Siddhis of Śiva; (अणिमा लघिमा प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्यं महिमा तथा ।
 ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च तथा कामावसायिता).

The superhuman power of becoming as small as an atom, one of the 8
 powers or Siddhis of Śiva; (अणिमा लघिमा प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्यं महिमा तथा ।
 ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च तथा कामावसायिता).
+ .{@-कः@} A small kind of grain. See अणु.

अणूभू^1 €1 P. To become minute or atomic.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170124. note: By some grammar rule the vowel lengthens.
